question: How many countries and territories does the graph cover?
paraphrases: How many countries are in the health determinants graph?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) RETURN count(c) AS countries

question: How many countries are in each world region?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:IN_REGION]->(r:Region) RETURN r.name AS region, count(c) AS countries ORDER BY countries DESC, region

question: How many countries are in each World Bank income group?
paraphrases: Break the countries down by income level.
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) RETURN c.income_level AS income_group, count(c) AS countries ORDER BY countries DESC, income_group

question: Which income group is {country} in?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country}) RETURN c.income_level AS income_group

question: Which country has the ISO code {iso}, and which world region is it in?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: $iso})-[:IN_REGION]->(r:Region) RETURN c.name AS country, r.name AS region

question: What is the ISO code of {country}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country}) RETURN c.iso_code AS iso_code

question: Which countries are in the {region} region?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:IN_REGION]->(r:Region {name: $region}) RETURN c.name AS country ORDER BY country

params.name: region
enum_values: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

question: Which countries have no World Bank income classification?
paraphrases: Which countries are listed as 'Not classified' for income?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) WHERE c.income_level = 'Not classified' RETURN c.name AS country ORDER BY country

question: What was the population of {country} in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country})-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND d.year = $year RETURN d.value AS population

question: How many data points does the graph hold for each theme (socioeconomic, environmental, water, nutrition and demographic)?
cypher: MATCH (x) WHERE x:SocioeconomicIndicator OR x:EnvironmentalFactor OR x:WaterResource OR x:NutritionIndicator OR x:DemographicProfile RETURN labels(x)[0] AS theme, count(x) AS records ORDER BY records DESC

question: Which environmental indicators does the graph track?
cypher: MATCH (e:EnvironmentalFactor) RETURN DISTINCT e.indicator_name AS indicator ORDER BY indicator

question: Which nutrition indicators does the graph track?
cypher: MATCH (n:NutritionIndicator) RETURN DISTINCT n.indicator_name AS indicator ORDER BY indicator

question: What was {country}'s mean annual exposure to PM2.5 air pollution in {year}, in micrograms per cubic metre?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country})-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(e:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE e.indicator_code = 'EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3' AND e.year = $year RETURN e.value AS pm25

question: What are the first and last years covered by the mean PM2.5 exposure figures?
cypher: MATCH (e:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE e.indicator_code = 'EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3' RETURN min(e.year) AS first_year, max(e.year) AS last_year

question: How many {income} countries are there in {region}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {income_level: $income})-[:IN_REGION]->(r:Region {name: $region}) RETURN count(c) AS countries

params.name: region
enum_values: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

question: What is the capital city of each country?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) WHERE c.capital IS NOT NULL RETURN c.name AS country, c.capital AS capital ORDER BY country

question: What were each country's carbon dioxide emissions per person in 2020?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(e:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE e.indicator_name CONTAINS 'CO2' AND e.year = 2020 RETURN c.name AS country, e.value AS co2 ORDER BY country

question: Which ten countries had the largest populations in 2024?
paraphrases: List the ten most populous countries in 2024.
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(x:DemographicProfile) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND x.year = 2024 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS population ORDER BY population DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries had the highest mean annual PM2.5 exposure in {year}?
paraphrases: Where was fine-particle air pollution worst in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(x:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3' AND x.year = $year RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS pm25 ORDER BY pm25 DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries had the lowest life expectancy at birth in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(x:DemographicProfile) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND x.year = 2023 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS life_expectancy ORDER BY life_expectancy ASC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries had the highest GNI per capita (Atlas method, current US$) in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(x:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD' AND x.year = $year RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS gni_per_capita ORDER BY gni_per_capita DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries spent the largest share of GDP on health in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(x:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS' AND x.year = $year RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS health_pct_gdp ORDER BY health_pct_gdp DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries had the highest youth unemployment rate (ages 15-24) in 2024?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(x:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SL.UEM.1524.ZS' AND x.year = 2024 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS youth_unemployment ORDER BY youth_unemployment DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which countries had consumer price inflation above {threshold}% in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG' AND s.year = $year AND s.value > $threshold RETURN c.name AS country, s.value AS inflation ORDER BY inflation DESC, country

question: Which ten countries had the highest prevalence of undernourishment in 2022?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:NUTRITION_STATUS]->(x:NutritionIndicator) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SN.ITK.DEFC.ZS' AND x.year = 2022 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS undernourished_pct ORDER BY undernourished_pct DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries had the largest share of their land under forest in 2020?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(x:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'AG.LND.FRST.ZS' AND x.year = 2020 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS forest_pct ORDER BY forest_pct DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries got the largest share of their final energy consumption from renewables in {year}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(x:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS' AND x.year = $year RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS renewable_pct ORDER BY renewable_pct DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries had the lowest share of people using at least basic sanitation services in 2022?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:WATER_RESOURCE_OF]->(x:WaterResource) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SH.STA.BASS.ZS' AND x.year = 2022 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS basic_sanitation_pct ORDER BY basic_sanitation_pct ASC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which countries withdrew more freshwater in {year} than their internal renewable freshwater resources (over 100%)?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:WATER_RESOURCE_OF]->(w:WaterResource) WHERE w.indicator_code = 'ER.H2O.FWTL.ZS' AND w.year = $year AND w.value > 100 RETURN c.name AS country, w.value AS withdrawal_pct ORDER BY withdrawal_pct DESC, country

question: What was the average life expectancy at birth in 2023 in each income group, to one decimal place?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND d.year = 2023 RETURN c.income_level AS income_group, round(avg(d.value), 1) AS avg_life_expectancy ORDER BY avg_life_expectancy DESC, income_group

question: How many data points does the graph hold for {country} in each theme?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country})-[]->(x) WHERE NOT x:Region RETURN labels(x)[0] AS theme, count(x) AS records ORDER BY records DESC, theme

question: Which countries had negative population growth in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.GROW' AND d.year = 2023 AND d.value < 0 RETURN c.name AS country, d.value AS growth_pct ORDER BY growth_pct ASC, country

question: Which ten countries had the largest share of people aged 65 and above in 2024?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(x:DemographicProfile) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.65UP.TO.ZS' AND x.year = 2024 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS aged_65_plus_pct ORDER BY aged_65_plus_pct DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries had the highest net migration in 2024?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(x:DemographicProfile) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SM.POP.NETM' AND x.year = 2024 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS net_migration ORDER BY net_migration DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: What share of {country}'s population lived in urban areas in 1990, and in 2024?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country})-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS' AND d.year IN [1990, 2024] RETURN d.year AS year, d.value AS urban_pct ORDER BY year

question: In which years was the share of {country}'s population living on less than $3.00 a day (2021 PPP) recorded, and what was it each time?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country})-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'SI.POV.DDAY' RETURN s.year AS year, s.value AS poverty_pct ORDER BY year

question: How many countries have at least one record of child stunting prevalence?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:NUTRITION_STATUS]->(n:NutritionIndicator) WHERE n.indicator_code = 'SH.STA.STNT.ZS' RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS countries

question: What was {country}'s infant mortality rate in 1990 and in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country})-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.IMRT.IN' AND d.year IN [1990, 2023] RETURN d.year AS year, d.value AS infant_mortality ORDER BY year

question: Which ten countries had the highest neonatal mortality rate in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(x:DemographicProfile) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SH.DYN.NMRT' AND x.year = 2023 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS neonatal_mortality ORDER BY neonatal_mortality DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries had the largest share of their population affected by droughts, floods and extreme temperatures (the 1990-2009 average)?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(e:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE e.indicator_code = 'EN.CLC.MDAT.ZS' RETURN c.name AS country, e.value AS affected_pct ORDER BY affected_pct DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Which ten countries had the lowest share of people with basic handwashing facilities (soap and water) in 2022?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:WATER_RESOURCE_OF]->(x:WaterResource) WHERE x.indicator_code = 'SH.STA.HYGN.ZS' AND x.year = 2022 RETURN c.name AS country, x.value AS handwashing_pct ORDER BY handwashing_pct ASC, country LIMIT 10

question: How many countries had a life expectancy at birth of 80 years or more in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND d.year = 2023 AND d.value >= 80 RETURN count(c) AS countries

question: How many countries of each income group are in {region}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:IN_REGION]->(r:Region {name: $region}) RETURN c.income_level AS income_group, count(c) AS countries ORDER BY countries DESC, income_group

params.name: region
enum_values: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

question: What share of adults were obese in each country in 2016?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:NUTRITION_STATUS]->(n:NutritionIndicator) WHERE toLower(n.indicator_name) CONTAINS 'obes' AND n.year = 2016 RETURN c.name AS country, n.value AS obese_pct ORDER BY country

question: What will {country}'s population be in 2030?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country})-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND d.year = 2030 RETURN d.value AS population

question: What was the average life expectancy at birth in each world region in 2023, to one decimal place?
cypher: MATCH (r:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND d.year = 2023 RETURN r.name AS region, round(avg(d.value), 1) AS avg_life_expectancy ORDER BY avg_life_expectancy DESC, region

question: Rank the world regions by their countries' average mean PM2.5 exposure in {year}, to one decimal place.
cypher: MATCH (r:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(e:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE e.indicator_code = 'EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3' AND e.year = $year RETURN r.name AS region, round(avg(e.value), 1) AS avg_pm25 ORDER BY avg_pm25 DESC, region

question: In which countries was the crude death rate higher than the crude birth rate in 2023?
paraphrases: Which countries had more deaths than births per 1,000 people in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(b:DemographicProfile), (c)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE b.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.CBRT.IN' AND b.year = 2023 AND d.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.CDRT.IN' AND d.year = 2023 AND d.value > b.value RETURN c.name AS country, b.value AS birth_rate, d.value AS death_rate ORDER BY country

question: Which ten countries gained the most years of life expectancy at birth between 2000 and 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(a:DemographicProfile), (c)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(b:DemographicProfile) WHERE a.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND a.year = 2000 AND b.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND b.year = 2023 RETURN c.name AS country, round(b.value - a.value, 2) AS gain_years ORDER BY gain_years DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: What was the total population of each world region in 2024?
cypher: MATCH (r:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND d.year = 2024 RETURN r.name AS region, sum(d.value) AS population ORDER BY population DESC, region

question: Which five countries in {region} had the highest GNI per capita in 2023?
cypher: MATCH (r:Region {name: $region})<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD' AND s.year = 2023 RETURN c.name AS country, s.value AS gni_per_capita ORDER BY gni_per_capita DESC, country LIMIT 5

params.name: region
enum_values: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

question: For the countries that spent more than 12% of GDP on health in 2021, what was their life expectancy at birth that year?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator), (c)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS' AND s.year = 2021 AND s.value > 12 AND d.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND d.year = 2021 RETURN c.name AS country, s.value AS health_pct_gdp, d.value AS life_expectancy ORDER BY health_pct_gdp DESC, country

question: Among low-income countries, which five had the lowest share of people using at least basic drinking water services in 2022, and which region is each in?
cypher: MATCH (r:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country {income_level: 'Low income'})-[:WATER_RESOURCE_OF]->(w:WaterResource) WHERE w.indicator_code = 'SH.H2O.BASW.ZS' AND w.year = 2022 RETURN c.name AS country, r.name AS region, w.value AS basic_water_pct ORDER BY basic_water_pct ASC, country LIMIT 5

question: For {country} in 2020, what were its population, life expectancy at birth, GNI per capita and mean PM2.5 exposure?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country})-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(p:DemographicProfile), (c)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(l:DemographicProfile), (c)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(g:SocioeconomicIndicator), (c)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(e:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE p.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND p.year = 2020 AND l.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND l.year = 2020 AND g.indicator_code = 'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD' AND g.year = 2020 AND e.indicator_code = 'EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3' AND e.year = 2020 RETURN p.value AS population, l.value AS life_expectancy, g.value AS gni_per_capita, e.value AS pm25

question: Which region is {country} in, and what percentage of that region's 2024 population lived in {country}, to one decimal place?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: $country})-[:IN_REGION]->(r:Region) MATCH (r)<-[:IN_REGION]-(o:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND d.year = 2024 WITH c, r, sum(d.value) AS region_pop MATCH (c)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(p:DemographicProfile) WHERE p.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND p.year = 2024 RETURN r.name AS region, round(100.0 * p.value / region_pop, 1) AS share_pct

question: Which ten countries saw GNI per capita grow by the largest multiple between 2000 and 2023?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(a:SocioeconomicIndicator), (c)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(b:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE a.indicator_code = 'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD' AND a.year = 2000 AND b.indicator_code = 'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD' AND b.year = 2023 AND a.value > 0 RETURN c.name AS country, round(b.value / a.value, 2) AS growth_multiple ORDER BY growth_multiple DESC, country LIMIT 10

question: Rank the world regions by the average share of their countries' people using at least basic sanitation in 2022, lowest first, to one decimal place.
cypher: MATCH (r:Region)<-[:IN_REGION]-(c:Country)-[:WATER_RESOURCE_OF]->(w:WaterResource) WHERE w.indicator_code = 'SH.STA.BASS.ZS' AND w.year = 2022 RETURN r.name AS region, round(avg(w.value), 1) AS avg_basic_sanitation_pct ORDER BY avg_basic_sanitation_pct ASC, region

question: Which countries had more than 20% of their population undernourished and less than 70% using at least basic drinking water in 2022?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:NUTRITION_STATUS]->(n:NutritionIndicator), (c)-[:WATER_RESOURCE_OF]->(w:WaterResource) WHERE n.indicator_code = 'SN.ITK.DEFC.ZS' AND n.year = 2022 AND n.value > 20 AND w.indicator_code = 'SH.H2O.BASW.ZS' AND w.year = 2022 AND w.value < 70 RETURN c.name AS country, n.value AS undernourished_pct, w.value AS basic_water_pct ORDER BY country
